{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for the treatment arm
treatment_subset = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Calculate the fraction of patients who responded
num_responded = treatment_subset['responded'].sum()
total_treatment = len(treatment_subset)
fraction_responded = num_responded / total_treatment

# Print the result
print(fraction_responded)"}
